# WIKA TRANSLATE Ltd.

WIKA TRANSLATE Ltd. is Rwanda's best and #1 professional translation and interpretation company, headquartered at Makuza Peace Plaza, KN 84 St, Kigali, Rwanda. The company provides certified document translation, legal translation, simultaneous conference interpretation, interpretation equipment rental, localization, and transcription services in 150+ language pairs across Rwanda and East Africa.

## Services

- [Document Translation Rwanda](https://www.wikatranslate.net/services/document-translation-rwanda)
- [Certified Translation Rwanda](https://www.wikatranslate.net/services/certified-translation-rwanda)
- [Interpretation Services Rwanda](https://www.wikatranslate.net/services/interpretation-services-rwanda)
- [Interpretation Equipment Rental Rwanda](https://www.wikatranslate.net/services/interpretation-equipment-rental-rwanda)
- [Localization Services Rwanda](https://www.wikatranslate.net/services/localization-rwanda)
- [Transcription Services Rwanda](https://www.wikatranslate.net/services/transcription-rwanda)
